abilities.name: Rockstar
abilities.description: Using a Basic Ability grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Heroic Abilities grant 50 Armor.; trait

fields.notes: When using Mosh Pit, Armor is granted after the initial channel finishes. Otherwise, the Armor is granted after casting the Ability is fully finished. Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.description: Slide to a location, dealing 105 damage and Stunning enemies hit for 1.25 seconds.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Dash

abilities.name: Mosh Pit
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, channel to Stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.; 120; 100; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Stationary channel, Stun
fields.notes: Interrupting Mosh Pit during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Stage Dive
abilities.description: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330 damage to enemies in the area, and Slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.; 75; 70; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Status effect, Movement: Teleport
fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Slow, Pseudo-Stasis (self)
fields.notes: Interrupting Stage Dive during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Stace Dive cannot be interrupted or prevented by Roots, unlike most other Movement Abilities. After successfully channeling, E.T.C is put in Stasis until landing. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, E.T.C is removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles) and has no collision, but he does not receive the initial expanded debuff removal. A warning AoE appears for both teams when the Ability has been cast successfully.

talents.description: While Guitar Solo is active, E.T.C. heals for 60% of his damage dealt by Basic Attacks. Basic Attacks increase the duration of Guitar Solo by 0.5 seconds.

talents.description: quest Gathering a Regeneration Globe permanently increases the healing per second of Guitar Solo by 5, to a maximum of 100. After gathering 20 Regeneration Globes, Guitar Solo also heals nearby allied Heroes for 50 Health every second while it is active.

talents.description: Rockstar gives allies a stack of Block, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next Hero Basic Attack for 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Maximum 2 stacks of Block.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.description: Face Melt does 300% more damage to enemies recently affected by Powerslide.

fields.notes: Pinball Wizard uses a separate damage value from Face Melt, causing the tooltip percentage to stack multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers.

talents.name: Hammer-on
talents.description: E.T.C's Basic Attacks deal 12% more damage, increased to 36% While Guitar Solo is active.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers.

talents.name: Echo Pedal
talents.description: Using a Basic or Heroic Ability releases two pulses of 18 damage. This deals 200% bonus damage to Minions and Mercenaries. The first occurs instantly. The second occurs 2 seconds later.

fields.notes: Pulses do not stack. The second pulse for one Ability will not occur if you use another Ability before it activates. Note that the second pulse will always occur right when the Armor from Rockstar expires, so the visual icon for this Trait in the bottom left may help time Abilities for waveclear. When using Powerslide or Stage Dive, the first pulse is fired upon reaching the end location. When using Mosh Pit the first pulse is fired right after the windup completes. Damage bonus to Minions and Mercenaries stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers.

_raw_fields: Using a Basic or Heroic Ability releases two pulses of 18 damage. This deals 200% bonus damage to Minions and Mercenaries. The first occurs instantly. The second occurs 2 seconds later.

talents.name: Imposing Presence
talents.description: cooldown 20 Active Activate to Slow the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds. Passive Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Attack Slow, Slow
fields.notes: Passive is not applied if the enemy Basic Attack misses due to being Blinded. Passive Attack Slow does not stack with itself, nor the active component. Passive and active Attack Slow stack additively with other effects that can affect the target Hero's Attack Speed.
